senses.gloss: m. (פָּלַח) soldier, officer. Y’lamd. to Lev. V, 21, quot. in Ar., v. פָּגָן.—Pl. פּוֹלְחִין. Ib. to Deut. VII, 17, quot. in Ar. דרכן של פ׳ לובשין וכ׳ it is the custom of soldiers to wear nail-studded shoes.
units: <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:17">Ib.</cite> to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 19:1">Deut. XIX, 1</cite>, quot. in Ar. <he>מוסרין … שני פ׳ וכ׳</he> they give each Israelite two soldiers to guard him.
